# Mark DK Berry

This came from 
[https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Promptor](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Promptor)

I have it working with openrouter but not got it working with Local LM Studio yet.

There's a lot of improvements this thing needs to work better and I logged them here but he's not come back to it yet - [https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Promptor/issues/18](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Promptor/issues/18)


## EXAMPLE PRE-PROMPT TO SET GUIDELINES

### Example 1:

This was to control floral embellishment and keep the resulting prompt tight.

```
when a dialogue begins, cut to that persons image and stay with it until their dialogue ends. do not embellish extra mood, action, or camera movements. camera should be static on each shot and show only what is seen in the image provided. this is four people having a conversation over the internet using webcams. so each person gets the full screen for the entire duration of their dialogue. shot then cuts to the next person the moment the next person starts talking. keep the context simple and concise. no embellishing, other than exactly what is there in the images. no background music. no environment sounds, only the dialogue for each person.

image 1 is mdkb is wearing dark sunglasses who speaks with a strong London cockney accent and standing centre image with a blue hue bunker scene in the background.
image 2 is roger waters (Roger) who speaks with an english posh accent.
image 3 is ed sheeran (Ed) who speaks with a weak english accent.
image 4 is Leonardo DiCaprio (Leonardo) speaks with a strong American accent.

the dialogue should be as follows.

mdkb speaking in a London cockney accent: "So Roger, talk to me. what's your beef with Ed?"

roger speaking in posh english accent: "He's sucking up all the propaganda of the socialist Israelis with their democratic ways. I went there man, I saw the apartheid... It's hell on earth."

mdkb speaking in a London cockney accent: "Anything you want to add, Ed?"
```
